paragraphs.text: Build the Work Around the Outcome.
Structure steps, ownership, dependencies, approvals, status, and review around a defined result.
Define the result the workflow is intended to produce before adding steps.
Define what may progress automatically, what must pause for approval, who can override it, and where policy, risk, or consequence requires human authorization.

sections.label: Define How Completion Will Be Judged
sections.title: Define How Completion Will Be Judged

paragraphs.text: Define How Completion Will Be Judged
For deliverable-based work, define outputs, acceptance criteria, evidence requirements, milestone value, revision rules, and release conditions before execution.
